messages:
jordan: Heads up - SierraEdge SI hit a blocker during a field run. Client certs failing at TLS handshake with our private proxy. Pilot is scheduled for tomorrow AM, need quick arch triage and mitigation plan.

liz: Ticket/link? who from SI is on the call now?

jordan: https://sierraedge.atlassian.net/browse/SE-4321 - on-call SE is Priya. They pasted logs in the ticket.

ashwin: suspect mTLS verification mismatch. Our proxy validates SAN=client-id by default; partner certs look like they only set subjectDN/org fields. Can you paste the exact error?

jordan: from the proxy logs: ```
2026-03-22T22:10:42Z proxy[2378]: TLS handshake failed: certificate verification error: SAN mismatch (expected client-id)
2026-03-22T22:10:42Z proxy[2378]: peer_subject="/C=US/ST=CA/O=SierraEdge/OU=Field/CN=node-23"
```

sam: if it's SAN vs subjectDN we can either relax verification (accept subjectDN) or route affected endpoints around the proxy temporarily. Relaxation is quickest but increases blast radius.

anya: ops POV - bypassing the proxy needs network ACL changes; could be done, but would also remove RBAC checks. Not ideal for customer.

ashwin: I can prepare a minimal proxy patch that accepts subjectDN for a given tenant flag (config flag tenant.allow_subject_dn=true). That keeps it behind proxy and scoped. I can have a patch + smoke CI in ~3h.

liz: customer wants pilot. Is 3h realistic for today's rollout window?

jordan: pilot is at 09:00 PT tomorrow. If we merge tonight and do a canary, ops can flip the flag in staging first.

sam: agree with canary. Need rollback plan: config toggle + traffic split. Ops will hold the hot-rollback playbook.

ashwin: posting PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/proxy/pull/981. Patch is small: adds subjectDN allowlist option and a per-tenant toggle. Tests included.

deploy-bot: CI: test/proxy-smoke passed for branch allow-subject-dn (run #230).

anya: I'll coordinate the canary rollout steps with infra: create canary route for tenant=sierraedge, monitor TLS success rate and latency for 30m, then promote.

liz: I'll message Priya and confirm they'd accept a scoped config change (not a cert reissue). Also loop legal if we need signoff for relaxed verification.

jordan: thanks - action items: ashwin -> merge & ship patch (ETA 3h), anya -> canary route + rollback plan, liz -> confirm SI OK and legal check, sam -> stand by for canary monitor.

ashwin: on it. Will ping here when PR is merged.

liz: :thumbsup: good catch everyone, let's not surface this in the pilot.

jordan: updating the ticket with this plan and tagging customer-facing PM. Will post final call time in thread.

ashwin: PR merged at 02:12 UTC, deploying to staging canary now.

deploy-bot: deploy: proxy-staging/canary -> success (rev a9f3c7)

anya: canary looks stable so far - TLS success 99.6% after 10m, no errors. Continuing to monitor.

sam: standing by for production window. If SLA metrics spike we abort and revert toggle.

jordan: great. will reconvene in morning if anything else pops up.

liz: thanks team - saved a customer pilot.
